data.title: W / 维什戴尔 · 最后一块点心
data.description: 盘子里还剩最后一块点心。她用叉子轻轻指了指，问你要不要；你刚伸手，她已经把盘子推到了你面前。
data.action: 用叉子指向盘里的点心
data.camera: 中景，点心盘与人物同框
data.promptProse: At a sunlit corner table of a sweet shop, W playfully aims a silver dessert fork at the last powdered pastry on an ornate ceramic plate. Dappled afternoon light streams through a striped outdoor awning, illuminating delicate crumbs on the table, glass display cases filled with colorful cakes, and W's amused, daring expression as she dares the viewer to take it.
